主要内容: On January 2, 2019, the Buyer of BLONDER TONGUE LABORATORIES INC provided notice to the Seller that it is exercising its right to extend the closing date for up to an additional 20 calendar days. In connection with this notice, the Buyer paid an Extension Deposit of $150,000 to the Seller. As a result, the Buyer has up to an additional 20 calendar days following January 10, 2019, to close the transaction. The filing also includes a 'Safe Harbor' statement regarding forward-looking statements, which are subject to risks and uncertainties. The company undertakes no obligation to revise these statements in the future. The filing was published on January 4, 2019, and signed by Eric Skolnik, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of BLONDER TONGUE LABORATORIES INC.
